item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:30 HKT 26/Feb/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon now affecting the coast of Guangdong will moderate gradually today and tomorrow. The weather will be generally fine over the region and the temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. A humid easterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China next week. It will be cloudier and misty over the region.
